Layout-oracle pairs: groups/ and visuals/.

Each pair has a legacy/ project and Desktop's PBIR conversion of it.

- legacy/ was generated by BIcraft: `cargo xtask layout-oracle gen`, `bicraft run`, `install`.
  The model, data and report content are our own synthetic material.
- The PBIR side was written by Power BI Desktop 2.159.883.0 (Store) when it opened and saved our
  generated project with `tools/layout-oracle/run.ps1`. This is a black-box observation.

The files contain no Microsoft-authored content: no base themes, images or other Desktop resources.
They are compared by crates/engine/tests/layout_oracle.rs. See docs/formats/legacy-layout-bb.md
and its source log.
